senses.gloss:
(I)--A Samhikeya Asura: a son of ह्राद and Dhamani. Cooked वातापि for his guest Agastya. A fol- lower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra.
1: Br. III. 6. १९; भा. VI. १८. १५.
Got exhausted in अमृतमथन।
2: Ib. VII. 2. 4; VIII. 7. १४.
Took part in देवासुर war between Bali and Indra and fought with the sons of ब्रह्मा.
3: Ib. VIII. १०. २० & ३२.
Father of Balvala.
4: Ib. X. ७८. ३८.
